question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The bridge __that connect__ the two sides of the city broke today.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the verb form "**connect**" which does not agree with the singular subject "**bridge**."
 
• When the subject is singular, the verb should be "**connects**" to ensure subject-verb agreement.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**that connects**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"The bridge that connects the two sides of the city broke today."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "that have been connecting" **– This option is incorrect as it suggests a continuous action that does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "that have connect"** – This option is grammatically incorrect as it mixes present perfect with an incorrect verb form.
 
• **Option 4: "that has connect"** – This option is incorrect as it uses an incorrect verb form.
